request_note: Trac-migrated issue body (otter, 2014-06-27) preserved verbatim, with the 'Reported by' line and migration footnote removed and backslash escaping undone
historical_wrong_note: Changed u = h - R*T in BaseProperties to u = h - R*(T-T0), making the two locations consistent but violating h - u = p/d; hnaderan pointed this out in 2014-12, and otter ruled in 2015-01 that the fix should follow h=u+pv
final_correct_note: Final trunk state: cc794bac/6c57d814 changed specificInternalEnergy to cp_const*(state.T-T0) - R_gas*state.T, and 8e5c1bf9 restored BaseProperties to u = h - R*T; 3.2.1 maintenance branch 84000601
invariant: PartialSimpleIdealGasMedium (and its instance SimpleAir): for all (p,T), h - u = p/d = R_gas*T (enthalpy definition h=u+pv), while BaseProperties.u equals specificInternalEnergy(state); the reference temperature T0 can only shift the common zero point of h and u and cannot change their difference
convention_note: The historical discussion included a dispute over the "reference-state convention" (hubertus), but otter settled it on the grounds that h=u+pv holds for any reference state; the invariant is independent of the choice of reference state. Classified as not a convention dispute (under a stricter reading it could be marked as a boundary case)
